Zain: Alright! Finally, the chatty one.
Jade: Hiya! What do you mean, the chatty one?
Zain: Nah, from your picture. I had you down as someone who doesn't stop talking.
Jade: Rude! Accurate, but rude. I'm Jade, Barnsley.
Zain: Zain, Bolton. Gemma said your husband's a sparky as well?
Jade: Yeah, Liam! He's in Wakefield all week. Honestly, there's been about three electricians today, it's like I can't escape them.
Zain: We're everywhere, mate. Who's he with?
Jade: Just a local firm. He's always on about going on his own, but he's dead cautious.
Zain: See, I'm going on my own in two years. EV chargers, solar. Everyone keeps telling me to get someone for the paperwork, mind. Callum, Gemma, now probably you.
Jade: Oh, Callum's told me off as well! He said the insurance for my nails takes twenty minutes and I've been putting it off for eight months. I felt dead stupid. Like, I've got all the kit in the spare room, lamps, gels, the lot, and I've just not filled in a form. So I've said I'll do it tonight. Whether I actually will, do you know what I mean.
Zain: Do it tonight. Then you can tell Callum. He'll be made up. Well, he'll say "good".
Jade: Ha, he will, won't he! He were nice though. His dog chewed the remote as well.
Zain: Everyone's dog in this study eats remotes. What d'you do of a night then, with Liam away?
Jade: Married at First Sight, mostly. Don't judge me.
Zain: Judge you? Sana makes me watch that. I pretend I'm on my phone but I'm proper invested.
Jade: Shut up! Who's your favourite couple?
Zain: I'm not answering that on a recording, mate.
Jade: Ha! What's Sana do?
Zain: Dental nurse. Makes me floss. It's a nightmare living with her.
Jade: Aw. Do you go away much? I'm desperate for a holiday, we're skint at the minute but I'd love Dubai.
Zain: I've done Dubai with the lads. It's mad, everything's massive. Go in winter, though, summer you'll melt. And book it yourself, don't do a package, you'll save loads. I spend ages finding deals, it's like a hobby. Got Japan lined up next if I can talk Sana into it.
Jade: Japan! That's dead far. I'd just do Tenerife again to be honest.
Zain: Nothing wrong with Tenerife.
Jade: Did you have a Chinese last night as well? Because everyone seems to have had a Chinese.
Zain: Nah, my mum's tea. She sends me home with tubs every Sunday, I'm still eating them on Wednesday.
Jade: That's like my mam with Sunday dinner. Oh, I think we've got like a minute.
Zain: Go on then. Insurance. Tonight.
Jade: Tonight! I swear.
